items.claim: gantt month/year duration from a month's end overflows into the next month
items.note: The drag read-back now counts calendar months too. The existing test that pinned the overflow (`2026-01-31` + `1M` → `03-03`) now expects `02-28`, which is what Day.js gives.

items.claim: gantt branch or id rename leaves later references on the old name (A+B, branch half)
items.note: It now refuses a name another branch holds, including the main branch.

items.claim: gitgraph commit id change leaves cherry-picks naming the old id
items.note: This covers a cherry-pick's `parent` too, and dropping an id renames to the id the commit is given automatically. It now refuses an id another commit holds.

items.claim: `setGitCommandKind` fills a merge or cherry-pick with a branch or commit it can't use
items.note: The fill now comes from the history before `at`. The existing test that expected a converted commit to pick its own vanished id now expects `''`.

items.claim: `moveGanttTaskToSection` within one section reads `at` after removal, and throws at the section's length
gantt drag past year 9999 or before 0 writes a date its format can't read
items.note: `formatGanttDate` now keeps dates within the years the format reads back. The same defect sat in `YY` (1969–2068) and in formats with no year (1970), and both are fixed. Recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: long forward `after` chain overflows the stack
items.note: The test hit `RangeError` before the fix. Dependencies are now resolved on an explicit stack in the same order, so cycles resolve as before.

items.claim: `ganttDurationBetween` counts excluded days past `WALK_LIMIT`, so a long task shrinks on edit
`todayMarker` `rgb()`/`hsl()` stroke is cut at its first comma
PlotView undo after a resize or theme change restores marks for the old size and theme
items.note: The prop sync moved into `plotViewSync.ts`, and an undo or redo that brings back a chart drawn for older props redraws it, without adding a history entry. The test covers both undo and redo.
